senses.gloss: राज् rā́j, m. (nm. ṭ) ruler, king (C. only —˚).

रज raj-a, m. (rare): dust;
 pollen of flowers.

राज rāj-a, m. (—˚ = rājan) prince, king;
 🞄chief of: -ṛṣi, m. = rājarṣi.
रजःकण rajaḥ-kaṇa, m. grain of dust: pl. dust.

राजत rājata, a. (ī) made of silver;
 n. silver.

रजन ráj-ana, a. (ī) colouring (V.);
 m. ray 🞄(rare).

रजःस्पृश् rajaḥ-spṛś, a. touching (the dust 🞄=) the earth;
 -sveda-samanvita, pp. 🞄covered with dust and sweat.
रजिका raj-ikā, f. (of -aka) washerwoman.

राजिक rāj-ika, a. relating to kings (only 🞄—˚): ā, f. black mustard;
 black mustard 🞄seed (used as a measure of weight).

रजिष्ठ ráj-iṣṭha, V. spv. (of rigu) straightest;
 🞄most righteous.

रजोजुष् rajo-juṣ, a. joined with the quality 🞄of passion;
 -megha, m. cloud of dust.
रज्जु rájj-u, f. [√ rasj*, bind: cp. √ majj] 🞄cord, rope (—˚, of rarely = for): -m ā-sthā, 🞄have recourse to the rope, hang oneself.

राजकीय rājak-īya, a. royal;
 m. servant 🞄of a king.
राजताद्रि rājata‿adri, m. silver mountain, 🞄Mount Kailāsa.
राजन् 2. rāj-án, n. (?) guidance (RV.¹).
राजन्वत् rājan-vat, a. having or ruled by a 🞄good king.
राजमानत्व rāja-māna-tva, n. brilliance, 🞄splendour (abst. ɴ. fr. pr. pt. of √ rāj).
राजस rājas-a, a. (ī) belonging or relating 🞄to the quality rajas, endowed with passion: 🞄-tva, n. subjection to the quality of passion.
राजानक rājāna-ka, m. petty prince.
राजाय rājā-ya, den. Ā. behave like a king, 🞄play the king.
राजि rā́j-i, राजी rāj-ī, f. [distinct mark: 🞄√ rā́j], line, streak, row.
राजी rāj-ī, f. = राजि rā́j-i.
राजिचित्र rāji-citra, m. (variegated with 🞄stripes), a kind of snake.
राजिन् rāj-in, a. shining.
राज्ञी rā́jñ-ī, f. (of rā́jan) queen.
